_help: Every physical tag, by role. Empty strings are spare slots that are not programmed yet - fill them in as you read the UIDs (tap the tag and watch '[Bridge] NFC: <uid>' in the serial monitor), then run generate_player_configs.py. Up to 8 tags per role. Planned counts: 3 per player, 3 start, 3 narrator, 6 overlay1, 6 overlay2.
